sentences.en: The specialist can show the parents how to position the baby's head up, in good body alignment, because a baby with Edwards' syndrome may have hyperextension of the head.

sentences.en: A night of tension regarding Bryant's knee hyperextension Tuesday night in San Diego rendered positive reports after Wednesday's practice.

sentences.en: Prevents hyperextension of, knees and occlusion of popliteal artery caused by pressure from body weight. Trochanter roll prevents external rotation of legs.

sentences.en: Back hyperextension: Lying on stomach, extend the body, let arms and legs fully stretch out.
